title: The 2000s R'n'B Quiz
subtitle: Four rounds. Twenty seconds a question. Fastest fingers win.
notes: Written by claude-sonnet-5 for "2000s R'n'B". NOT YET REVIEWED — read every question in the editor before the gig.

questions.prompt: Which group had a 2000s hit with 'Say My Name'?
questions.answerNote: 'Say My Name' won Destiny's Child two Grammy Awards in 2001.

questions.prompt: Alicia Keys scored a huge hit in 2001 with which piano-led song?
questions.answerNote: 'Fallin'' won three Grammy Awards including Song of the Year.

questions.prompt: Which duo had a 2004 hit with 'My Boo'?
questions.answerNote: 'My Boo' topped the US chart and was a UK top ten hit too.

questions.prompt: Ciara's breakthrough 2004 hit, featuring Petey Pablo, was called what?
questions.answerNote: 'Goodies' became a UK top five hit and launched Ciara's career.

questions.prompt: Chris Brown's 2005 debut single, which reached UK number one, was called what?
questions.answerNote: 'Run It!' topped the UK singles chart in early 2006.

questions.prompt: Which singer had a 2007 hit with 'Buy U a Drank (Shawty Snappin')?
questions.answerNote: T-Pain's heavy use of Auto-Tune became a defining sound of late-2000s R'n'B.

questions.prompt: Ne-Yo's 2006 debut album, which included 'So Sick', was titled what?
questions.answerNote: 'So Sick' gave Ne-Yo his first UK number one as a lead artist.

questions.prompt: Which singer had a 2008 hit with 'No Air', a duet with Jordin Sparks?
questions.answerNote: 'No Air' spent several weeks in the UK top ten during 2008.

questions.prompt: Usher's 2004 album featuring 'Yeah!' and 'Burn' was titled what?
questions.answerNote: Confessions became one of the biggest-selling R'n'B albums of the decade.

questions.prompt: Which male singer released the 2004 hit 'Slow Jamz' with Kanye West and Twista?
questions.answerNote: Jamie Foxx sang the hook, mixing his acting career with a chart hit.

questions.prompt: Which British singer's debut solo single 'Fill Me In' went to UK number one in 2000?
questions.answerNote: He had already featured on Artful Dodger's 'Re-Rewind' the year before.

questions.prompt: Which singer spent fourteen weeks at US number one in 2005 with 'We Belong Together'?
questions.answerNote: It marked her comeback with the album The Emancipation of Mimi.

questions.prompt: Which St. Louis artist had 2002 hits with 'Hot in Herre' and 'Dilemma'?
questions.answerNote: 'Dilemma' paired him with Kelly Rowland of Destiny's Child.

questions.prompt: Whose 2004 single 'Let Me Love You' spent nine weeks at US number one?
questions.answerNote: He was nineteen when it topped the chart.

questions.prompt: Which American singer had a 2003 hit with 'Milkshake'?
questions.answerNote: It was produced by The Neptunes.

questions.prompt: What was the title of Beyoncé's 2003 debut solo album?
questions.answerNote: It won her five Grammy awards in a single night.

questions.prompt: Which Jamaican artist had 2000s hits with 'Get Busy' and 'Temperature'?
questions.answerNote: Both came off albums that crossed dancehall into the pop charts.

questions.prompt: Which British singer had 2003 hits with 'Superstar' and 'Thank You'?
questions.answerNote: 'Thank You' was written about leaving an abusive relationship.

questions.prompt: Which singer's 2005 hit '1 Thing' was built on a sample of The Meters?
questions.answerNote: It came from the soundtrack to the film Hitch.

questions.prompt: Which British singer, a Fame Academy runner-up, had hits with 'Dance (With U)' and '50/50'?
questions.answerNote: He won three MOBO awards in 2003.

rounds.title: Round Three — Whose Face Is This?
rounds.blurb: The picture pulls back as the clock runs down. Guess early, score more.

questions.prompt: Whose face is this?
questions.answerNote: Omarion fronted the group B2K before launching a solo career with O.
questions.imagePrompt: A young Black man with short neat hair, boyish smooth face, fitted casual streetwear, dance-pop R'n'B teen-idol charisma.

questions.prompt: Whose face is this?
questions.answerNote: Akon had massive UK success with Lonely and later features on Snoop Dogg and Eminem tracks.
questions.imagePrompt: A Black man with a bandana or cap, thick beard, sleepy-eyed expression, casual hoodie, husky-voiced singer-rapper look from the mid-2000s.

questions.prompt: Whose face is this?
questions.answerNote: Ashanti's self-titled debut album made her one of the biggest R'n'B stars of 2002.
questions.imagePrompt: A young Black woman with long wavy caramel-highlighted hair, glossy lips, hoop earrings, sweet approachable early-2000s pop-R'n'B look.

questions.prompt: Whose face is this?
questions.answerNote: Alicia Keys broke through in 2001 with the album Songs in A Minor.
questions.imagePrompt: A young Black woman with long braided cornrows, warm brown skin, wearing simple gold hoop earrings, seated confidently at a piano, early-2000s soulful glamour look.

questions.prompt: Whose face is this?
questions.answerNote: Ja Rule scored huge UK hits duetting with Ashanti and Jennifer Lopez in the early 2000s.
questions.imagePrompt: A muscular Black man with a shaved head, bandana tied over his hair, gruff expression, heavy gold chains and tattoos on his arms.

questions.prompt: Whose face is this?
questions.answerNote: Aaliyah was known as the Princess of R'n'B before her death in 2001.
questions.imagePrompt: A young Black woman with sleek straight dark hair swept over one eye, wearing tinted sunglasses and a crop top, cool late-90s/early-2000s streetwear style.

questions.prompt: Whose face is this?
questions.answerNote: Ne-Yo wrote hits for others before launching his own solo career with So Sick.
questions.imagePrompt: A slim Black man wearing a flat cap or fedora tilted low, tinted sunglasses, sharp tailored suit, smooth polished R'n'B crooner look.

questions.prompt: Whose face is this?
questions.answerNote: Missy Elliott's Get Ur Freak On became a defining club anthem of the early 2000s.
questions.imagePrompt: A confident Black woman with bold short hairstyles that change often, oversized sunglasses, baggy tracksuits, playful futuristic streetwear style.

questions.prompt: Whose face is this?
questions.answerNote: Jay-Z topped the UK charts multiple times in the 2000s including with Numb/Encore.
questions.imagePrompt: A Black man with a shaved head, sharp goatee beard, wearing a crisp button-down shirt or blazer, understated hip-hop mogul style, calm confident expression.

questions.prompt: Whose face is this?
questions.answerNote: TLC's Chris Lopes-Lee, Tionne Watkins and Rozonda Thomas scored a huge 2000s hit with No Scrubs.
questions.imagePrompt: Three Black women in colourful matching baggy outfits with bold accessories, varied hairstyles from braids to short cropped cuts, playful 90s/2000s girl-group energy.
